output.reason_for_conversation: deciding whether to stop a medication due to side effects
output.summary: User started Ozempic 3 weeks ago and reports daily nausea despite able to drink water; eats small portions but feels too full and queasy, worse with fried foods and at night. Bot explained nausea as a common early side effect, suggested dietary adjustments (small bland meals, avoid fried foods), and clarified that dose increases are not fixed and can be delayed. User was initially considering stopping the medication; bot discouraged this without doctor input and explained risks. Bot provided warning signs requiring urgent care (persistent vomiting, dehydration, severe abdominal pain). User's morning blood sugar has improved from 140-150 to around 120, and user accepted a plan to eat smaller meals, avoid fried foods, monitor blood sugar more regularly, and discuss dose timing with doctor before increasing.
